SELECT
    coalesce(a.ProductCategoryName, b.ProductCategoryName) AS ProductCategoryName,
    ifNull(a.actual_sales_revenue, 0) AS actual_sales_revenue,
    ifNull(b.budget_revenue, 0) AS budget_revenue,
    ifNull(a.actual_sales_revenue, 0) - ifNull(b.budget_revenue, 0) AS variance_to_budget
FROM
(
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS actual_sales_revenue
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
) AS a
FULL OUTER JOIN
(
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        sum(fsp.Amount) AS budget_revenue
    FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan AS fsp
    INNER JOIN retail.DimScenario AS s
        ON fsp.ScenarioKey = s.ScenarioKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimAccount AS acc
        ON fsp.AccountKey = acc.AccountKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON fsp.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(fsp.DateKey) = 2009
      AND s.ScenarioName = 'Budget'
      AND acc.AccountName = 'Sales Amount'
    GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
) AS b
    ON a.ProductCategoryName = b.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY ProductCategoryName;
